_about: Hand-written review of each mismatch scripts/verify_bulbapedia.py reports, checked against pret/pokeemerald where the two sources disagree.

mismatches.route-118: Gabby & Ty: the app lists their first battle on Route 111 (data/scripts/gabby_and_ty.inc); the Route 118 and 120 battles are rematches. OK.
mismatches.route-120: Gabby & Ty rematch, see Route 118. OK.
mismatches.mossdeep-city: Bulbapedia puts the Wingull boy's Mental Herb under Mossdeep; the decomp gives it in FortreeCity_House4 (the boy's Wingull carries mail to Mossdeep). App is right.
mismatches.dewford-town: Battle Girl Shauna/Jocelyn is one trainer with a hover name on Bulbapedia; matched as Jocelyn. OK.

order.route-105: App lists Routes 105-108 where you can Surf them; Bulbapedia mentions them first on Mr. Briney's boat ride. By design.
order.route-118: App lists Route 118 when you can Surf across it; Bulbapedia mentions the west bank earlier. By design.
order.lilycove-city: Safari Zone needs the Pokéblock Case from Lilycove. Added a step saying so.
order.route-132: Optional currents after Pacifidlog; either order works.
order.desert-underpass: Post-game optional areas; order is free.
order.sealed-chamber: Post-game optional areas; order is free.
order.desert-ruins: Post-game optional areas; order is free.

not_covered: Bulbapedia's Emerald Part 22 (Southern Island, Faraway Island, Birth Island, Navel Rock) doesn't exist on the wiki, so those four event islands stay Draft.
corrections: Hiker Mike in Rusturf Tunnel was missing: build_data.py treated TRAINER_MIKE_2 as a rematch, but MIKE_1 is never battled.
Gabby & Ty were missing: their battles live in data/scripts/gabby_and_ty.inc, which the map pass didn't read. Now on Route 111.
TM43 (Secret Power) gift on Route 111 was missing (shared script data/scripts/secret_power_tm.inc).
Rayquaza is catchable as soon as it returns to Sky Pillar after the Sootopolis event (VAR_SKY_PILLAR_STATE >= 2), not only after the Hall of Fame.
Sky Pillar: the first climb needs no bike; the Mach Bike is needed when you come back for Rayquaza.
Cave of Origin: Wallace waits on B1F, and Zubat, Golbat and Sableye live there (the old step said nothing could be caught).
Route 123: one-way ledges run west to Route 118; the Giga Drain girl checks for a Grass-type in your party, not a Grass move.
Route 132: the currents are west of Pacifidlog, not east.
Route 115: you can walk there north from Rustboro.
Verdanturf: Wally is staying with his cousin Wanda's family.
Desert Underpass: reached through the Fossil Maniac's cave on Route 114.
Safari Zone: needs the Pokéblock Case; the extra areas open with the National Pokédex.
